layoutContract.chartTray: collapsible bottom overlay, 52 px collapsed, 360 px / ≤58% open
layoutContract.mobilePortrait: full map, bottom sheet ≤ 64dvh with sticky close, compact Aha card on the map while the sheet is closed

mapContract.basemap: generated at runtime by js/map-style.js on https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet (OpenMapTiles schema) with --basemap-* tokens; no hosted style URL; labels name:th first; no POI/housenumber/boundary labels; sky/fog fade the distance into the paper colour
mapContract.layerOrder: landcover/water → data fill (before waterway) → 2D footprints → roads → massing + host buildings (before water-name) → labels → outlines/pins/logos
mapContract.massing: city tier = native fill-extrusion from the building source-layer in --basemap-massing-quiet (3D only, zoom ≥ 13); focus tier = same tiles decoded, offset outward and corner-rounded so they enclose the original, in --basemap-massing-focus (display-only answer to maplibre-style-spec #1047); OSM twins of host buildings hidden by feature id
mapContract.camera: plan (pitch 0) · city (pitch 56, bearing 28) · model (pitch 60, FOV 14, near-axonometric) for a neighborhood, fitted to fill the frame · eye (pitch 75, FOV 24 = two-point perspective with the horizon kept outside the frame; MapLibre 5.6.2 draws fill-extrusion wrongly once the horizon enters) as the venue-level default, framed on the venue's host building
mapContract.choropleth: count family, five equal-interval classes from the current maximum, fill-opacity 1 beneath the basemap's first line layer, off at zoom ≥ 14.5, EVID-05 measured / measured_zero / out_of_scope
mapContract.pins: one declared point-of-sale row per pin; zoom tiers <12 / 12–14 / ≥14; context pins grey and logo-less; screen displacement with leader lines, source coordinates unchanged
mapContract.logos: ≤ 250, only at zoom ≥ 14 and only inside the focus
mapContract.venues: source building footprints/parts with explicit height provenance in map.activeLayer; unknown heights use a marked 3 m display slab; visible in plan and 3D
mapContract.neighborhoods: frozen named analytical road/river envelopes with production province codes; no arbitrary radius components; no claimed consumer consensus
mapContract.breadcrumb: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › ย่าน › สถานที่; province codes BKK PKT CMI SPK NBI CBI PTE UDN NMA as observed on landometer.com 2026-10-22; venue id = CityMETER Shopping Center id; ย่าน of a venue by point-in-polygon; store is the heading, not a crumb
mapContract.venueLevel: only the venue's rows carry detail (blue host, category pins, logos); other venues' buildings fall back to quiet massing and their pins to grey context dots; SCENE.eye lowers massing opacity (city 0.16 / focus 0.62) and buildings standing between the camera and the venue are drawn at 0.14 opacity; the city tier is 0.22 elsewhere and fades to the ground tone by distance from the focus (500 → 2200 m)

brandIdentity.sources: 155 official brand sources; 13 retailers; source artwork embedded unchanged, outer whitespace cropped in viewport only
brandIdentity.fallback: Visible brand names and accessible marker labels retained; logos are identity, not a metric or endorsement

chartContract.matrix: table-layout fixed with a colgroup; every cell the same size; caption says size carries no meaning; cell tint = count class
